title: free-disk-space source component diagram
description: The modules of the one free-disk-space binary and what each reaches outside the process. The scan records directories, file names and compression candidates in a SQLite state file; compress and dedupe act only on what it recorded; clean and the daemon work without it. All modules are compiled into one process; none is deployed on its own.

components.name: free-disk-space source
components.responsibility: The binary's code: one module per command family plus shared helpers.

components.name: Command line (main.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses the subcommands and flags with clap, fills in defaults such as the state path, and dispatches to the command modules.

components.name: Scan (scan.rs)
components.responsibility: Walks a root directory, recording every directory, every file's path, leaf name and size, and the compression candidates, in the state file; resumable after Ctrl-C; also list.

components.name: Compression (compress.rs)
components.responsibility: Compresses pending candidates in place: clones each file into a temp file beside the original, has the lzfse module put the LZFSE compressed form on the clone, verifies it and swaps it in by rename; first checks with a probe file that a compressed copy reads back compressed and unchanged, and tallies skips by reason.

components.name: Clone dedupe (dedupe.rs)
components.responsibility: Hashes same-named, same-sized files the scan recorded and replaces identical ones with verified copy-on-write clones of one kept copy.

components.name: Compression repair (repair.rs)
components.responsibility: Checks every file the scan recorded for a false compression claim: resets files recorded as compressed that are not, records flagged files with broken compressed data, and rewrites flagged files that save no space through compress's verified path.

components.name: Decompression (decompress.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds the transparently compressed files under the given files and folders, reports the space they would take plain, refuses when the volume lacks it, and with --apply rewrites each through repair's plain copy and compress's verified swap, recording it so compress leaves it alone.

components.name: Largest entries (top.rs)
components.responsibility: Walks a folder on several threads without following symlinks or leaving its volume and lists the largest folders and files by allocated size, counting hard-linked files once and noting what it cannot read.

components.name: Status (status.rs)
components.responsibility: Gathers scan progress, candidates by status, recorded file names, free space and the daemon's state into one JSON value with ok and problems, and prints it as text or JSON.

components.name: Cleanup (clean.rs)
components.responsibility: Deletes regenerable files per target: caches, Xcode derived data, Downloads, Trash, dev build artifacts, Homebrew's cache and Docker's images and build cache, with a running total; records the steps an applying run finishes so an interrupted run resumes after them; also the process snapshot dedupe reuses.

components.name: Daemon (daemon.rs)
components.responsibility: Checks free space on an awake-time cadence and runs clean when it is below a threshold; installs, removes and reports itself as a launchd login item.

components.name: Helpers (util.rs)
components.responsibility: Output and colour, sizes, progress lines, the Ctrl-C stop flag, subprocesses with time limits, free space, awake time, display state, BSD file flags, hashes and xattr names.

components.name: File metadata (meta.rs)
components.responsibility: Reads every extended attribute's value (without the compression attributes) or a single one, the ACL as text and the birth time; sets an attribute, the birth time and BSD flags, and copies an ACL onto an open file; tells whether a file has a real resource fork and whether two files' flags (apart from the compressed flag) and times match, so compress can check a copy keeps them and repair can rebuild one.

components.name: LZFSE library wrapper (lzfse.rs)
components.responsibility: Maps a file read-only and calls the lempel-ziv-finite-state-entropy-compression library to compress it into decmpfs attributes and apply them to an open copy, naming the failed step on error; off macOS the copy stays plain.

components.name: lempel-ziv-finite-state-entropy-compression C library
components.responsibility: Vendored LZFSE compressor (src/macos/lempel-ziv-finite-state-entropy-compression, MPL-2.0), compiled into the binary by build.rs: lzfse_zazzcat_decmpfs_compress builds the com.apple.decmpfs header and resource fork on all cores, and lzfse_zazzcat_decmpfs_apply sets them on a file, empties its data fork and sets the compressed flag.

components.name: Scan state file
components.responsibility: A SQLite database (bundled by rusqlite) at $FDS_STATE or ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/scan.sqlite3, holding the scan's settings, progress, directories, file names and candidates.

components.name: Clean progress file
components.responsibility: A text file at ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/clean-progress.txt, one finished step per line (dir:, dev: or target: and its name), kept only while an applying clean is interrupted and for at most 12 hours.

components.name: APFS clone and metadata calls
components.responsibility: macOS clonefile and copyfile, called directly to clone a file copy-on-write (for dedupe and for compress's temp copy) and copy its ACL, mode, owner, flags, times and xattrs; the xattr, ACL and setattrlist calls meta uses.

components.name: macOS file tools
components.responsibility: /usr/bin/xattr (extended attribute names and removal).

components.name: Process listing tools
components.responsibility: lsof (open files and working directories) and ps (command lines) of running processes.

components.name: git
components.responsibility: Tells whether a build artifact directory is inside a work tree, ignored and untracked.

components.name: Finder
components.responsibility: Empties the Trash when asked through osascript.

components.name: Docker Desktop
components.responsibility: Prunes images and build cache, stops containers and quits, through the docker CLI and osascript.

components.name: Homebrew
components.responsibility: Removes its old downloads and versions (brew cleanup --prune=all -s).

components.name: launchd
components.responsibility: Starts the daemon at login and keeps it running, from the plist the install writes; driven with /bin/launchctl.
